newsitem.title: UK: BOC says JV wins Indonesian contract.
newsitem.headline: BOC says JV wins Indonesian contract.

text.p: BOC Plc said on Monday that its BOC Gases division and a joint venture partner had won a contract to supply oxygen and power to PT Smelting Co in East Java, Indonesia.

In a statement, BOC Gases said it would invest 70 million pounds in the project with its joint venture partner, Garama Group of Indonesia. It said the contract was the largest ever awarded to BOC Gases.
PT Smelting is a joint venture between Mitsubishi Materials Corp, PT Freeport Indonesia Co and other partners, and is constructing Indonesia's first copper smelter and refinery at Gresik, East Java.
BOC said BOC Gases and its partner were to install Indonesia's largest air separation plant with oxygen capacity in excess of 1,000 tonnes per day, and the project would come on stream in 1998.
